subject.title: macOS: replace modal browser cookie-import prompt with an inline dashboard banner

question: Should the macOS app adopt the linked inline dashboard banner as the permanent presentation for the optional browser-cookie import offer?
rationale: The proposal intentionally changes native onboarding UX and dashboard ownership, and the protected maintainer label reserves that product choice for explicit human approval.

options.title: Approve banner direction
options.body: Review and land the linked PR if its dashboard integration and preserved import-state semantics are correct.

options.title: Retain modal presentation
options.body: Close the linked PR and keep the current alert flow if the dashboard should not own this optional offer.

recommendation.title: Approve banner direction
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked PR if its dashboard integration and preserved import-state semantics are correct.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current import experience and authored the active redesign, giving them the strongest history-backed context for this decision.
